description: D-003 option A ordinary-client route proof with the invitee elected as the sole match authority. Two clean clients retain peer-to-peer social topology, but only the invitee starts the in-client ENet listen host and publishes a signed typed match-server route; the initiating inviter consumes that route in one idempotent join. This fixture deliberately excludes window-focus, Needler, distribution, and visual assertions so route ownership remains independently verifiable.

input_sequence.comment: Each ordinary client waits for the signed route, exact ready gate, current-v58 stage load, local player allocation, and spawn.
Require a continuous usable-gameplay window without focus, visual, weapon, or direct transport assistance.
Exit both clean clients after stable gameplay; route ownership and lifecycle assertions are already causally complete.
